evidence.observation: O2 settled at ~4-6 ppm after purge and through the ramp
O2 has risen steadily through growth: 9.4, 14.6, 19.8, 26.2 ppm (~5 ppm per 120 s)
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so less argon dilution does not explain the rise
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermal side looks nominal
Pressure gauge not installed; the growth stage requires it, so the tube atmosphere cannot be fully checked
